newsitem.title: JAPAN: Pioneer Electric bid-only after ratings upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer Electric bid-only after ratings upgrade.

text.p: Pioneer Electronic Corp shares were bid only in early Thursday morning trade after a research institute upgraded its ratings, brokers said.
As of 0035 GMT, the shares were bid-only at 2,230 yen after closing at 2,150 on the previous day.
Nomura Research Institute Ltd upgraded Pioneer Electronic Corp to a "1" from its previous "2".

In its three-grade rating system, the research institute assigns a "1" rating to issues whose values it expects will outperform the key 225-share Nikkei average by more than 10 percentage points over the following six months.
The research institute believes Pioneer's business is likely to improve, officials said.
It expects Pioneer's operating profits to hit 2.0 billion yen compared to a previous forecast of a 2.0 billion loss in the year to March 31, 1997.
